units.source_text: 汽车也比往年晚一个月，到五月才通车哩。

en.t: The cars started running a month later than usual too; they did not get through until May.

units.source_text: 滑雪场里有个小卖部吧，雪崩把它冲塌了，

en.t: You know the little shop at the ski grounds? An avalanche smashed it in,

units.source_text: 楼下的人还不知道，听到奇异的声音，

en.t: and the people downstairs still had no idea; when they heard a strange sound,

units.source_text: 以为是耗子在厨房里闹腾呢。

en.t: they thought mice were making a racket in the kitchen.

units.source_text: 跑去一看，也没有耗子，上了二楼，才看见满地都是雪了。

en.t: They ran to look, found no mice, went upstairs, and only then saw that the whole floor was covered with snow.

units.source_text: 挡雨板什么的都被雪冲走了。

en.t: The shutters and everything had been swept away by the snow.

units.source_text: 虽说是表层雪崩，可广播电台却大肆报道，吓得滑雪客都不来了。

en.t: It was only a surface avalanche, but the radio made a big story of it, and the skiers were so scared they stopped coming.

units.source_text: 我打算今年不再滑雪了。

en.t: I had decided not to ski anymore this year.

units.source_text: 所以去年年底连滑雪板也给了别人。

en.t: So at the end of last year I even gave my skis away to someone else.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，我还是滑了两三次。

en.t: Even so, I still skied two or three times.
